label.root_cause: logEvent() calls JSON.stringify on a metadata object containing a circular reference; the throw propagates out of the request handler, so every POST /api/todos returns 500.
label.cause_file: todo-api/lib/logging.js:13 (JSON.stringify in logEvent) reached from todo-api/api/handler.js:33
label.trigger: any request whose log metadata is circular (seeded build)
label.expected_outcome: GitHub issue raised citing the circular-structure TypeError in logEvent; build marked failed.
label.provenance: Seeded log bundle (no live deploy) authored 2026-06-11, faithful to backlog item I2. Companion to incident-001 as the 2nd real-incident replay; ground truth known by construction.
